primary.title: Gold Falls Most in Two Months as Jobs Fuel Fed Rate-Hike Bets
primary.summary: Gold fell the most in more than two months as robust US jobs data fueled bets that the Federal Reserve will likely raise interest rates this year, a headwind for the precious metal.
